title: Minute by minute - THE DOOBIE BROTHERS

lines.l: I know I could turn, blink and you'd be gone
But I must be prepared, any time to carry on
By minute, by minute, by minute, by minute
I keep holding on, I keep holding on
I keep holding on, I keep holding on
Oh, baby, you would stay just to watch me, darling
Filtered where lies from you
Can't stop the habit of living on the run
Take it all for a crown, like you're the only one
Living all around, somehow that sounds nice
You think I'm your fool, but you may just be right
Cause I've been, I've been, I've been
I keep holding on
I've been holding on
Yes, I've been holding on
I've been, I've been, I've been
I keep holding on
I keep holding on
Call my name and I'll be gone
You reach out and I won't be there
Just my luck, you'll realize
You should spend your life with someone
You could spend your life with someone
I'll be holding on
No, no, no, no, baby
I'll be holding on
I'm a woman.
